name: agentos
description: AgentOS template marketplace: vendored upstream defaults + AgentOS channel + native plugins.

plugins.name: agent-sdk-dev
plugins.description: Development kit for working with the Claude Agent SDK (scaffolds new SDK projects, py/ts verifiers).

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated code review for pull requests using multiple specialized agents with confidence-based scoring.

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Streamline your git workflow with simple commands for committing, pushing, and creating pull requests.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Security reminder hook that warns about potential security issues when editing files (command injection, XSS, unsafe code patterns).

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram bot channel + reply tools (single-server: tools + channel capability via long-poll).

plugins.name: template-dev
plugins.description: Fork-ahead workflow for AgentOS template: bootstrap personal repo from template, sync upstream updates, manage template-managed vs personal-owned files.

plugins.name: agentos-core
plugins.description: Slash commands for managing AgentOS instance: /agentos:status, /agentos:restart, /agentos:verify, /agentos:logs, /agentos:peers, /agentos:heartbeat.
